newsitem.title: USA: Northern Alternative signs Northern States deal.
newsitem.headline: Northern Alternative signs Northern States deal.

text.p: Northern Alternative Energy Inc said Monday it signed two power purchase agreements with Northern States Power Co to build wind farms and sell the energy to Northern States.

Northern Alternative will build the wind farms for a total of about $30 million. The projects will be located near Lake Benton, Minnesota, and construction is due to begin in late summer and early fall of 1997. The agreements are subject to approval by the Public Utilities Commission, the company said.

Northern Alternative will sell energy generated by the wind farms to Northern States under a 30-year power contract. Northern States said the projects are part of its commitment to install 425 MW of wind generation by 2002.
Annual energy output form the combined projects is expected to exceed 58 million kilowatt-hours, enough energy to power almost 7500 homes.
